title: Robertson 2013 change in ligament pre-strain under 444 N compression

quantity.name: change in pre-strain
quantity.definition: change in ligament strain (percent points) between unloaded neutral and 444 N compressive load through the centre of rotation

source.authors: Robertson DJ, Von Forell GA, Alsup J, Bowden AE
source.sample: 71 ligaments (30 ALL, 27 SSL, 14 ISL) from 3 cadaveric T1-S1 spines; +10 ligaments (4 ALL, 3 ISL, 3 SSL) for the 444 N test; human thoracolumbar ALL, SSL, ISL in situ (neutral posture fixed with pedicle screws/plates)

protocol.summary: Spine placed in neutral posture and fixed posterolaterally (plates + pedicle screws); tattoo-ink optical markers on ALL (12), ISL (4), SSL (2); calibrated photographs in situ, then each ligament excised and allowed to reach stress-free state and re-photographed; pre-strain = (in situ length - free length)/free length between markers. Room temperature, isotonic saline mist. Load test: single-level FSUs potted, 444 N compressive follower-type load through centre of rotation, photographs with/without load.
how_to_simulate: Apply 444 N compression through the FSU centre of rotation (moment < 7.3 Nm)
Report change in ligament strain along the stated directions

extraction.check_notes: Table 2 read from render. Levels of the 10 FSU ligaments not specified per value. doi not printed.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
